environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'internal-geo-restrict' that blocks non-US source IPs with priority 50, (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 100. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for S3 (gateway endpoint) and CloudWatch Logs (interface endpoint). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with encryption at rest. The task definition sets the container user to uid 1000 (non-root).

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, HTTP/2 enabled
config.network: private subnet, no internet gateway, egress only via VPC endpoints (S3 gateway, CloudWatch Logs interface)
